facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹11.99 lakh cr, +20% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹95,625 cr, −2% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹3.31 lakh cr (+30% YoY), PAT ₹29,550 cr (+34% YoY), operating margin 17.1%.
Revenue has compounded at 15% over 10 years, 18% over 5 and 6% over 3; the last twelve months (+20%) are running ahead of the 3-year pace.
Profit and revenue have compounded at a similar pace over 3 years (5% vs 6%).
Quarterly revenue growth has accelerated over the last four quarters: +10% → +12% → +27% → +30% YoY.
Operating margin is steady at 17.1% (18.0% a year ago).
Borrowings are ₹4.05 lakh cr against equity of ₹9.44 lakh cr: debt/equity 0.43× (was 0.63× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 7.2× over the last twelve months.
Capital work-in-progress is ₹2.33 lakh cr, 20% of fixed assets — a large build-out not yet earning.
The cash conversion cycle has lengthened to 25 days from 7 in Mar 2023 (debtor days 12 → 20, payable days 91 → 84): more cash is tied up in operations.
Promoters hold 50.4%, +0.4 pp over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹7.55 lakh cr of operating cash came from ₹7.58 lakh cr of operating profit: 100% conversion; against PAT of ₹3.98 lakh cr that is 1.9×.
Free cash flow was negative in 1 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹1.29 lakh cr, latest year ₹70,023 cr.
Capex ran at 12% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹1.22 lakh cr (averaged 15% over the three years before).

business.what: Reliance Industries Limited is a diversified conglomerate operating in digital services, retail, media and entertainment, oil-to-chemicals, and oil and gas. It generates revenue through the sale of products, telecom services, retail commerce, media content, and hydrocarbon production.

synthesis.one_liner: Reliance delivers accelerated revenue growth and strong cash conversion, but management provides zero checkable company-level guidance.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management reports strong momentum across digital, retail, and energy sectors with expanding market positions.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Quarterly revenue growth accelerated over the last four quarters from 10.4% to 29.8% YoY, reaching ₹3.31 lakh cr in Sep 2026.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Business units are scaling rapidly toward long-term targets like doubling retail EBITDA and reaching ₹1 lakh cr in FMCG.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Trailing twelve month PAT fell 2% to ₹95,625 cr, and operating margin compressed to 17.1% from 18.0% a year ago.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Capital expenditures support massive new energy and infrastructure projects for future dominance.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Capital work-in-progress stands at ₹2.33 lakh cr or 20% of fixed assets, with annual capex running at ₹1.22 lakh cr.

synthesis.credibility: Management's say-do record cannot be scored because all 11 guidance items are unmeasured segment targets rather than verifiable company-wide metrics. Executives consistently deflect questions on ARPU, retail margins, and cash burn.

bull.evidence: Sep 2026 quarterly revenue reached ₹3.31 lakh cr, up 29.8% year-on-year.
Five-year operating cash conversion reached 100% of operating profit, yielding ₹1.29 lakh cr in cumulative free cash flow.
Borrowings of ₹4.05 lakh cr against equity of ₹9.44 lakh cr resulted in a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.43x.

bear.evidence: Trailing-twelve-month PAT dropped 2% to ₹95,625 cr while revenue grew 20% to ₹11.99 lakh cr.

bear.point: Capital tied up in unproductive assets
bear.evidence: Capital work-in-progress reached ₹2.33 lakh cr, representing 20% of total fixed assets.
The cash conversion cycle lengthened to 25 days in Sep 2026 from 7 days in March 2023.
